sub_fields.instructions: Edit it once under Reusable Sections and every page using it updates.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: section_label
sub_fields.instructions: Small text above the title, e.g. "The Travel Network Group". Optional.

sub_fields.label: Section buttons
sub_fields.name: section_ctas
sub_fields.instructions: Shown below the icons.

sub_fields.label: Box style
sub_fields.name: box_style
sub_fields.instructions: Boxes = title beside icon, ticked lists (membership pages). Cards = centred icon on top, alternating navy / blue (About "Principles").

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: box_columns
sub_fields.instructions: Default width for the boxes. Use each box's Width setting to build custom rows, e.g. three thirds, then two halves, then one wide box. Boxes on a row that doesn't fill up are centred.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon_picker
sub_fields.instructions: Pick from the icon set, or choose "Upload my own". Picked icons change colour to suit the background.

sub_fields.label: Upload icon
sub_fields.name: box_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional small icon beside the title.

sub_fields.label: Width
sub_fields.name: box_width
sub_fields.instructions: Stacks to full width on tablet and mobile.

sub_fields.label: Box colour
sub_fields.name: box_colour
sub_fields.instructions: Override this box's background, e.g. navy + blue pairs on the membership pages.

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: box_content
sub_fields.instructions: Bulleted lists show with blue tick icons.

sub_fields.label: Images / logos
sub_fields.name: box_images
sub_fields.instructions: Optional logos shown under the content (e.g. Global Travel Group / Worldchoice Plus).

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: box_link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional button at the bottom of the box.

sub_fields.label: Background
sub_fields.name: section_background
sub_fields.instructions: Navy = brand navy #1B2D70. Dark navy = #0F193D (staging dark sections).

sub_fields.label: Section ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional anchor for in-page links (letters, numbers and hyphens only), e.g. "apply".

sub_fields.label: Watermark
sub_fields.name: show_watermark
sub_fields.instructions: Brand shape behind the section.

sub_fields.instructions: Small text above the title, e.g. "The Travel Network Group". Optional.
